# Welcome

This is Part 3 of the analysis for the paper *"Knowledge Gaps and Sequencing Priorities for Mammalian eDNA Metabarcoding in the World's Largest Tropical Forest Country"*. It uses the species data prepared in `1_Prepare_data.Rmd` and the database completeness from `2_Assess_completeness_ambiguity_complementarity.Rmd`.

In this document, we model which species traits drive the inclusion of Brazilian mammals in reference databases, using Bayesian logistic regression with and without phylogenetic correction.

**Inputs:** `output/intermediate/1_Prepare_data.rds` (Part 1) and `output/intermediate/2_Assess_completeness_ambiguity_complementarity.rds` (Part 2).

**Outputs:** `output/intermediate/3_Drivers_of_database_omission.rds` and the fitted models in `output/models/`, used by Part 4; Figure 3, Tables S2-S3 and the related supplementary figures.

Fitting the models takes several hours. The fitted models are saved in `output/models/` and reused on later runs, unless the data or model specification change. Delete the files in `output/models/` to force a refit.

# 1. Explore effect of traits on species database inclusion probability

In this section, we model the probability that a species has at least one reference sequence for a given primer (database inclusion) as a function of species traits (body mass, habitat use, diet), conservation variables (IUCN Red List category, national and biome-level endemism) and indicators of scientific discovery (time since description, range size, human population density within the range), using Bayesian logistic regression. Inclusion is assessed regardless of sequence ambiguity, since the drivers of database inclusion are unrelated to those underlying sequence sharing.

## 1.1. Data preparation

**Combine database completeness with metadata:**

```{r}

  # Add the metadata

brz_mam_completeness_traits_all <- merge(brz_mam_completeness_all, brz_mam_metadata, by = "binomial", all = TRUE)

  # Add the taxonomy

brz_mam_completeness_traits_all <- merge(brz_mam_completeness_traits_all, brz_mam_taxonomy[, c("binomial", "order")], by = "binomial")

```

**Year of description:**

Recently described species are expected to be missing from reference databases, but the effect of time since description can only be detected if enough species were described recently. We summarise the number of species described per decade and their inclusion in the reference databases.

```{r, fig.width=12, fig.height=10}

# 1. Species described per decade, and their inclusion in the reference
#    databases (percentage of species-primer combinations with a sequence)

description_by_decade <- brz_mam_completeness_traits_all %>%
  filter(!is.na(year_described)) %>%
  mutate(decade = floor(year_described / 10) * 10) %>%
  group_by(decade) %>%
  summarise(n_species        = n_distinct(binomial),
            percent_included = mean(presence) * 100,
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(percent_species    = n_species / sum(n_species) * 100,
         cumulative_percent = cumsum(percent_species))

description_by_decade

save_table(description_by_decade, "species_described_by_decade", type = "additional")

# 2. Inclusion per decade of description, split by locus

inclusion_by_decade_locus <- brz_mam_completeness_traits_all %>%
  filter(!is.na(year_described)) %>%
  mutate(decade = floor(year_described / 10) * 10) %>%
  group_by(region, decade) %>%
  summarise(percent_included = mean(presence) * 100,
            n_species        = n_distinct(binomial),
            .groups = "drop")

inclusion_recent_by_locus <- inclusion_by_decade_locus %>%
  filter(decade >= 2000) %>%
  select(region, decade, percent_included) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = decade, values_from = percent_included)

inclusion_recent_by_locus

save_table(inclusion_by_decade_locus, "species_described_by_decade_and_locus", type = "additional")

# 3. Species described in the last 10 and 20 years (reference year 2025),
#    and since 2010 (reported in the main text)

year_described <- brz_mam_metadata$year_described[!is.na(brz_mam_metadata$year_described)]

percent_last_10    <- mean(year_described > 2015) * 100
percent_last_20    <- mean(year_described > 2005) * 100
percent_since_2010 <- mean(year_described >= 2010) * 100

cat("Species described since 2010:", round(percent_since_2010, 1), "% of Brazilian mammals\n")

# 4. Plot

locus_colours <- c("12S" = "#68a898", "16S" = "#b62c25", "COI" = "#f6b332", "Cytb" = "#2965a2")

p_described <- ggplot(description_by_decade, aes(x = decade, y = n_species)) +
  geom_col(fill = "grey60", width = 8) +
  labs(x = "Decade of description", y = "Number of species described") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12)

p_included <- ggplot(description_by_decade, aes(x = decade, y = percent_included)) +
  geom_line(colour = "grey40") +
  geom_point(aes(size = n_species), colour = "grey20", alpha = 0.8) +
  scale_size_continuous(name = "Species") +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 100)) +
  labs(x = "Decade of description", y = "Species-primer combinations with a sequence (%)") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12)

p_included_locus <- ggplot(inclusion_by_decade_locus,
                           aes(x = decade, y = percent_included, colour = region)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point(aes(size = n_species), alpha = 0.8) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = locus_colours) +
  scale_size_continuous(name = "Species") +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 100)) +
  labs(x = "Decade of description", y = "Species-primer combinations with a sequence (%)",
       colour = "Locus") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12)

description_plot <- (p_described | p_included) / p_included_locus +
  plot_annotation(tag_levels = "a")

description_plot

save_figure(description_plot, "FigS26_species_described_by_decade",
            width = 12, height = 10, type = "supplementary")

rm(p_described, p_included, p_included_locus, description_plot, locus_colours)

```

> **Interpretation**: `r round(percent_last_20, 1)`% of Brazilian mammal species were described in the last 20 years, and `r round(percent_last_10, 1)`% in the last 10 years (`r round(percent_since_2010, 1)`% since 2010), so recent descriptions are not rare. Their inclusion in the reference databases is very low: `r round(description_by_decade$percent_included[description_by_decade$decade == 2010], 1)`% and `r round(description_by_decade$percent_included[description_by_decade$decade == 2020], 1)`% of species-primer combinations have a sequence for species described in the 2010s and 2020s (panel b).
>
> The gap depends strongly on the locus (panel c). For species described since 2010, cytochrome b remains the best represented (`r round(inclusion_recent_by_locus[["2010"]][inclusion_recent_by_locus$region == "Cytb"], 1)`% for the 2010s), while 12S and 16S, targeted by most eDNA primers, are almost absent (`r round(inclusion_recent_by_locus[["2010"]][inclusion_recent_by_locus$region == "12S"], 1)`% and `r round(inclusion_recent_by_locus[["2010"]][inclusion_recent_by_locus$region == "16S"], 1)`%). New species are typically described using cytochrome b (and COI for bats), so their sequences are often not available for the loci used in eDNA metabarcoding.


```{r}

rm(description_by_decade, inclusion_by_decade_locus, inclusion_recent_by_locus,
   year_described, percent_last_10, percent_last_20, percent_since_2010)

```

## 1.2. Fitting Bayesian logistic regression models

**Check-out the missingness in our predictor variables:**

```{r}

missing_percent <- sapply(brz_mam_completeness_traits_all, function(x) mean(is.na(x)) * 100)

missing_percent[missing_percent > 0]

```

[Three of our predictors have missing values:]{.underline}

1.  Human population density in range (hum_pop_range): `r round(missing_percent[["hum_pop_range"]], 2)`% missing
2.  Body mass (BodyMass_g): `r round(missing_percent[["BodyMass_g"]], 2)`% missing
3.  Range size (RangeSize): `r round(missing_percent[["RangeSize"]], 2)`% missing

We will impute these missing variables using the existing predictors inside the model.

**Prepare the predictor variables for modelling:**

```{r}

# Step 1: Prepare the predictors

#   - Scale continuous predictors
#   - Set reference levels for categorical predictors
#   - Explicitly code missing categories where required


# Step 1a: Scale continuous predictors

# Time since description (no log transform, scale only)

brz_mam_completeness_traits_all$time_since_description_scaled <-
  scale(brz_mam_completeness_traits_all$time_since_description)

# Human population within species range (can be zero → log1p, then scale)

brz_mam_completeness_traits_all$hum_pop_range_scaled <-
  scale(log1p(brz_mam_completeness_traits_all$hum_pop_range))

# Body mass (no zeros → log-transform, keep NAs, then scale)

brz_mam_completeness_traits_all$BodyMass_g_scaled <-
  scale(log(brz_mam_completeness_traits_all$BodyMass_g))

# Geographic range size (no zeros → log-transform, keep NAs, then scale)

brz_mam_completeness_traits_all$RangeSize_scaled <-
  scale(log(brz_mam_completeness_traits_all$RangeSize))


# Step 1b: Set reference categories for categorical predictors

# Primer and taxonomic identity

brz_mam_completeness_traits_all$primer    <- as.factor(brz_mam_completeness_traits_all$primer)
brz_mam_completeness_traits_all$binomial <- as.factor(brz_mam_completeness_traits_all$binomial)

# Endemism

brz_mam_completeness_traits_all$brazilian_endemic <-
  factor(brz_mam_completeness_traits_all$brazilian_endemic)
brz_mam_completeness_traits_all$brazilian_endemic <-
  relevel(brz_mam_completeness_traits_all$brazilian_endemic, ref = "No")

brz_mam_completeness_traits_all$regional_endemic <-
  factor(brz_mam_completeness_traits_all$regional_endemic)
brz_mam_completeness_traits_all$regional_endemic <-
  relevel(brz_mam_completeness_traits_all$regional_endemic, ref = "No")

# Conservation status

brz_mam_completeness_traits_all$iucn_status <-
  factor(brz_mam_completeness_traits_all$iucn_status)
brz_mam_completeness_traits_all$iucn_status <-
  relevel(brz_mam_completeness_traits_all$iucn_status, ref = "LC")

# Locomotion

brz_mam_completeness_traits_all$locomotion <-
  factor(brz_mam_completeness_traits_all$locomotion)
brz_mam_completeness_traits_all$locomotion <-
  relevel(brz_mam_completeness_traits_all$locomotion, ref = "Te")


# Step 1c: Dietary guilds (binary predictors)

#   - Reference level set to absence ("0")

brz_mam_completeness_traits_all$Frugivore     <- relevel(as.factor(brz_mam_completeness_traits_all$Frugivore),     ref = "0")
brz_mam_completeness_traits_all$Omnivore      <- relevel(as.factor(brz_mam_completeness_traits_all$Omnivore),      ref = "0")
brz_mam_completeness_traits_all$Piscivore     <- relevel(as.factor(brz_mam_completeness_traits_all$Piscivore),     ref = "0")
brz_mam_completeness_traits_all$Insectivore   <- relevel(as.factor(brz_mam_completeness_traits_all$Insectivore),   ref = "0")
brz_mam_completeness_traits_all$Herbivore     <- relevel(as.factor(brz_mam_completeness_traits_all$Herbivore),     ref = "0")
brz_mam_completeness_traits_all$Myrmecivore   <- relevel(as.factor(brz_mam_completeness_traits_all$Myrmecivore),   ref = "0")
brz_mam_completeness_traits_all$Folivore      <- relevel(as.factor(brz_mam_completeness_traits_all$Folivore),      ref = "0")
brz_mam_completeness_traits_all$Seminivore    <- relevel(as.factor(brz_mam_completeness_traits_all$Seminivore),    ref = "0")
brz_mam_completeness_traits_all$Gummivore     <- relevel(as.factor(brz_mam_completeness_traits_all$Gummivore),     ref = "0")
brz_mam_completeness_traits_all$Granivore     <- relevel(as.factor(brz_mam_completeness_traits_all$Granivore),     ref = "0")
brz_mam_completeness_traits_all$Planktivore   <- relevel(as.factor(brz_mam_completeness_traits_all$Planktivore),   ref = "0")
brz_mam_completeness_traits_all$Teutophage    <- relevel(as.factor(brz_mam_completeness_traits_all$Teutophage),    ref = "0")
brz_mam_completeness_traits_all$Carnivore     <- relevel(as.factor(brz_mam_completeness_traits_all$Carnivore),     ref = "0")
brz_mam_completeness_traits_all$Hemovore      <- relevel(as.factor(brz_mam_completeness_traits_all$Hemovore),      ref = "0")
brz_mam_completeness_traits_all$Nectarivore   <- relevel(as.factor(brz_mam_completeness_traits_all$Nectarivore),   ref = "0")


```

**Fit a baseline model (no predictors):**

All models are fitted with a fixed seed and saved in `output/models/`. On later runs, the saved model is loaded instead of refitted, unless the data or model specification have changed.

```{r}

fit_0 <- brm(
  formula = bf(presence ~ 1),
  data = brz_mam_completeness_traits_all,
  family = bernoulli("logit"),
  prior = prior(normal(0, 1), class = "Intercept"),
  sample_prior = TRUE,
  chains = 4,
  iter = 4000,
  warmup = 2000,
  cores = 4,
  seed = 12345,
  save_pars = save_pars(all = TRUE),
  control = list(adapt_delta = 0.95),
  file = model_file("fit_0"),
  file_refit = "on_change"
)

```

**Fit a model without phylogenetic correction (Model 1):**

```{r}

fit_1 <- brm(
  
  # Presence model
  
  bf(presence ~ time_since_description_scaled + brazilian_endemic + iucn_status +
       locomotion + Frugivore + Omnivore + Piscivore + Insectivore + Herbivore +
       Myrmecivore + Folivore + Gummivore + Seminivore + Granivore + Carnivore +
       Hemovore + Nectarivore + regional_endemic +
       mi(hum_pop_range_scaled) + mi(BodyMass_g_scaled) + mi(RangeSize_scaled) + (1 | primer)) +
    
  # Imputation submodels for predictors with missing values
    
  bf(BodyMass_g_scaled | mi() ~ time_since_description_scaled + brazilian_endemic + iucn_status + locomotion + Frugivore + Omnivore + Piscivore + Insectivore + Herbivore + Myrmecivore + Folivore + Gummivore + Seminivore + Granivore + Carnivore + Hemovore + Nectarivore + regional_endemic,
     family = gaussian()) +
  bf(hum_pop_range_scaled | mi() ~ time_since_description_scaled + brazilian_endemic + iucn_status + locomotion + Frugivore + Omnivore + Piscivore + Insectivore + Herbivore + Myrmecivore + Folivore + Gummivore + Seminivore + Granivore + Carnivore + Hemovore + Nectarivore + regional_endemic,
     family = gaussian()) +
  bf(RangeSize_scaled | mi() ~ time_since_description_scaled + brazilian_endemic + iucn_status + locomotion + Frugivore + Omnivore + Piscivore + Insectivore + Herbivore + Myrmecivore + Folivore + Gummivore + Seminivore + Granivore + Carnivore + Hemovore + Nectarivore + regional_endemic,
     family = gaussian()),

  data = brz_mam_completeness_traits_all,
  family = list(bernoulli(), gaussian(), gaussian(), gaussian()),

  prior = c(
    
    # Presence model
    
    prior(normal(0, 0.5), class = "b", resp = "presence"),
    prior(normal(0, 1), class = "Intercept", resp = "presence"),
    prior(normal(0, 0.5), class = "sd", resp = "presence"),

    # Imputation submodels
    
    prior(normal(0, 0.5), class = "b", resp = "humpoprangescaled"),
    prior(normal(0, 1), class = "Intercept", resp = "humpoprangescaled"),
    prior(student_t(3, 0, 1), class = "sigma", resp = "humpoprangescaled"),

    prior(normal(0, 0.5), class = "b", resp = "BodyMassgscaled"),
    prior(normal(0, 1), class = "Intercept", resp = "BodyMassgscaled"),
    prior(student_t(3, 0, 1), class = "sigma", resp = "BodyMassgscaled"),

    prior(normal(0, 0.5), class = "b", resp = "RangeSizescaled"),
    prior(normal(0, 1), class = "Intercept", resp = "RangeSizescaled"),
    prior(student_t(3, 0, 1), class = "sigma", resp = "RangeSizescaled")
  ),

  chains = 4,
  iter = 4000,
  warmup = 2000,
  cores = 4,
  seed = 12345,
  control = list(adapt_delta = 0.98, max_treedepth = 15),
  save_pars = save_pars(all = TRUE),
  sample_prior = FALSE,
  file = model_file("fit_1"),
  file_refit = "on_change"
)

```

**Fit a model with phylogenetic correction (Model 2):**

```{r}

# 1. Order the phylogenetic correlation matrix as the species factor levels

correct_order <- levels(factor(brz_mam_completeness_traits_all$binomial))

phylacine_average_vcv_matrix_brz <- phylacine_average_vcv_matrix_brz[correct_order, correct_order]

rm(correct_order)

# 2. Fit the model

fit_2 <- brm(
  
  # Presence model, with a phylogenetic random effect
  
  bf(presence ~ time_since_description_scaled + brazilian_endemic + iucn_status +
       locomotion + Frugivore + Omnivore + Piscivore + Insectivore + Herbivore +
       Myrmecivore + Folivore + Gummivore + Seminivore + Granivore + Carnivore +
       Hemovore + Nectarivore + regional_endemic +
       mi(hum_pop_range_scaled) + mi(BodyMass_g_scaled) + mi(RangeSize_scaled) + (1 | primer) +
       (1 | gr(binomial, cov = phylacine_average_vcv_matrix_brz))) +
    
  # Imputation submodels for predictors with missing values
    
  bf(BodyMass_g_scaled | mi() ~ time_since_description_scaled + brazilian_endemic + iucn_status + locomotion + Frugivore + Omnivore + Piscivore + Insectivore + Herbivore + Myrmecivore + Folivore + Gummivore + Seminivore + Granivore + Carnivore + Hemovore + Nectarivore + regional_endemic,
     family = gaussian()) +
  bf(hum_pop_range_scaled | mi() ~ time_since_description_scaled + brazilian_endemic + iucn_status + locomotion + Frugivore + Omnivore + Piscivore + Insectivore + Herbivore + Myrmecivore + Folivore + Gummivore + Seminivore + Granivore + Carnivore + Hemovore + Nectarivore + regional_endemic,
     family = gaussian()) +
  bf(RangeSize_scaled | mi() ~ time_since_description_scaled + brazilian_endemic + iucn_status + locomotion + Frugivore + Omnivore + Piscivore + Insectivore + Herbivore + Myrmecivore + Folivore + Gummivore + Seminivore + Granivore + Carnivore + Hemovore + Nectarivore + regional_endemic,
     family = gaussian()),

  data = brz_mam_completeness_traits_all,
  data2 = list(phylacine_average_vcv_matrix_brz = phylacine_average_vcv_matrix_brz),
  family = list(bernoulli(), gaussian(), gaussian(), gaussian()),

  prior = c(
    
    # Presence model
    
    prior(normal(0, 0.5), class = "b", resp = "presence"),
    prior(normal(0, 1), class = "Intercept", resp = "presence"),
    prior(normal(0, 0.5), class = "sd", resp = "presence"),

    # Imputation submodels
    
    prior(normal(0, 0.5), class = "b", resp = "humpoprangescaled"),
    prior(normal(0, 1), class = "Intercept", resp = "humpoprangescaled"),
    prior(student_t(3, 0, 1), class = "sigma", resp = "humpoprangescaled"),

    prior(normal(0, 0.5), class = "b", resp = "BodyMassgscaled"),
    prior(normal(0, 1), class = "Intercept", resp = "BodyMassgscaled"),
    prior(student_t(3, 0, 1), class = "sigma", resp = "BodyMassgscaled"),

    prior(normal(0, 0.5), class = "b", resp = "RangeSizescaled"),
    prior(normal(0, 1), class = "Intercept", resp = "RangeSizescaled"),
    prior(student_t(3, 0, 1), class = "sigma", resp = "RangeSizescaled")
  ),

  chains = 4,
  iter = 4000,
  warmup = 2000,
  cores = 4,
  seed = 12345,
  control = list(adapt_delta = 0.98, max_treedepth = 15),
  save_pars = save_pars(all = TRUE),
  sample_prior = FALSE,
  file = model_file("fit_2"),
  file_refit = "on_change"
)

```

## 1.3. Inspecting and plotting results

**Posterior predictive checks:**

[Main models (Model 1 and Model 2)]{.underline}:

```{r, fig.width = 21, fig.height=21}


font_add_google("Roboto Condensed", "roboto_condensed")
showtext_auto()
showtext_opts(dpi = 400)

nc_theme <- theme_minimal(base_size = 14, base_family = "roboto_condensed") +
  theme(
    plot.title       = element_blank(),
    axis.line        = element_line(colour = "black", linewidth = 0.4),
    axis.ticks       = element_line(colour = "black", linewidth = 0.4),
    panel.border     = element_blank(),
    panel.background = element_blank(),
    panel.grid       = element_blank(),
    axis.text        = element_text(size = 16, colour = "black"),
    axis.title.x     = element_text(size = 18, colour = "black", face = "bold",
                                    margin = margin(t = 12)),
    axis.title.y     = element_text(size = 18, colour = "black", face = "bold",
                                    margin = margin(r = 12)),
    plot.margin      = margin(12, 12, 12, 12)
  )


# Model 1: Posterior predictive check plot 
# Panel a: bar plot; Panel b: SD histogram; Panel c: skewness histogram; 
# Panel d: per-primer mean. 

p_bars_1 <- pp_check(fit_1, type = "bars", ndraws = 1000, resp = "presence") +
  nc_theme

p_sd_1 <- pp_check(fit_1, type = "stat", stat = "sd", ndraws = 1000, resp = "presence") +
  nc_theme +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = scales::pretty_breaks(n = 2),
    labels = scales::label_number(accuracy = 0.001)
  )

p_skew_1 <- pp_check(fit_1, type = "stat", stat = "skewness", ndraws = 1000, resp = "presence") +
  nc_theme +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = scales::pretty_breaks(n = 3),
    labels = scales::label_number(accuracy = 0.01)
  )

p_primer_1 <- pp_check(fit_1, type = "stat_grouped", group = "primer", stat = "mean", 
                       ndraws = 1000, resp = "presence") +
  nc_theme +
  theme(
    strip.text  = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold", family = "roboto_condensed"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 11, angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 11),
    axis.title  = element_blank()
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = scales::pretty_breaks(n = 3))

composite_ppc_model1 <- (p_bars_1 | p_sd_1 | p_skew_1) / p_primer_1 +
  plot_layout(heights = c(1, 1.4)) +
  plot_annotation(tag_levels = "a", tag_suffix = ".") &
  theme(plot.tag = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold", family = "roboto_condensed"))

composite_ppc_model1

# Model 2: Posterior predictive check plot
```

```{r}
# Build, theme and save one trace-plot figure for a parameter group

make_trace_figure <- function(draws, pars, filename_stem, ncol_facets = 2) {
  
  p <- mcmc_trace(draws, pars = pars, 
                  facet_args = list(labeller = clean_labeller, ncol = ncol_facets)) +
    labs(x = "Post-warmup iteration", y = "Parameter value") +
    nc_theme +
    theme(
      strip.text = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold", family = "roboto_condensed"),
      axis.text  = element_text(size = 12, family = "roboto_condensed"),
      legend.position = "top"
    )
  
  n_pars  <- length(pars)
  n_rows  <- ceiling(n_pars / ncol_facets)
  
  fig_width  <- ncol_facets * 6      # ~6in per column
  fig_height <- n_rows * 3 + 1.5     # ~3in per row, + margin/legend allowance
  
  save_figure(p, filename_stem, width = fig_width, height = fig_height, type = "supplementary")
  
  return(p)
}
```

**Convergence diagnostics:**

First, we check the Rhat values, which is used to assess the convergence of the models. If Rhat values are close to 1 across all predictors, this is a sign that the different chains have converged well.

[Fixed effects]{.underline}:

```{r}
# Null model Rhat values  

summary(fit_0)$fixed[, 5:7] 
```

```{r}
# Model 1: no taxonomy - Rhat values  
summary(fit_1)$fixed[, 5:7] 
```

```{r}
# Model 2: with taxonomy - Rhat values  
summary(fit_2)$fixed[, 5:7] 
```

```{r}
# Convergence summary for the text: largest R-hat and smallest effective sample sizes

convergence_summary <- bind_rows(lapply(list(model_1 = fit_1, model_2 = fit_2), function(fit) {
  summ <- summary(fit)
  pars <- bind_rows(as.data.frame(summ$fixed), bind_rows(lapply(summ$random, as.data.frame)))
  data.frame(max_rhat = max(pars$Rhat), min_bulk_ess = min(pars$Bulk_ESS), min_tail_ess = min(pars$Tail_ESS))
}), .id = "model")

convergence_summary
```

```{r}
  "Habitat use | Reference category = Terrestrial",
  "Diet | Reference category = 0"
)

# Add "Overlapping 0?" and Direction columns

add_overlap_direction <- function(tbl) {
  tbl %>%
    mutate(
      `Overlapping 0?` = ifelse(`Lower 95% CI` <= 0 & `Upper 95% CI` >= 0, "Yes", "No"),
      Direction = case_when(
        `Overlapping 0?` == "Yes" ~ "None",
        Estimate > 0 ~ "Positive",
        TRUE ~ "Negative"
      )
    )
}

for (nm in names(models)) {
  
  fit <- models[[nm]]
  summ <- summary(fit)
  
  fixed_tbl <- as.data.frame(summ$fixed) %>%
    mutate(parameter = rownames(summ$fixed), effect = "fixed")
  
  random_tbl <- bind_rows(lapply(names(summ$random), function(g) {
    as.data.frame(summ$random[[g]]) %>%
      mutate(parameter = paste0(g, ": ", rownames(summ$random[[g]])), effect = "random")
  }))
  
  full_tbl <- bind_rows(fixed_tbl, random_tbl) %>%
    select(parameter, effect, Estimate, Est.Error,
           `l-95% CI`, `u-95% CI`, Rhat, Bulk_ESS, Tail_ESS)
  
  # Full, raw-precision table, including the imputation submodels
  
  save_table(full_tbl, paste0("all_parameters_", nm), type = "additional")
  
  # Inclusion submodel only, relabelled, grouped and ordered (Tables S2 and S3)
  
  presence_only_tbl <- full_tbl %>%
    filter(parameter %in% param_lookup$parameter) %>%
    left_join(param_lookup, by = "parameter") %>%
    mutate(group = factor(group, levels = group_order)) %>%
    rename(
      Parameter    = label,
      SD           = Est.Error,
      `Lower 95% CI` = `l-95% CI`,
      `Upper 95% CI` = `u-95% CI`,
      `R-hat`      = Rhat,
      `Bulk ESS`   = Bulk_ESS,
      `Tail ESS`   = Tail_ESS
    ) %>%
    add_overlap_direction() %>%
    mutate(across(c(Estimate, SD, `Lower 95% CI`, `Upper 95% CI`), ~ round(.x, 3)),
           `R-hat` = round(`R-hat`, 3),
           across(c(`Bulk ESS`, `Tail ESS`), ~ round(.x))) %>%
    # sort: group order first, then descending Estimate within each group
    # (Intercept and Random effects rows keep their natural single/short order)
    arrange(group, desc(Estimate)) %>%
    select(group, Parameter, Estimate, SD, `Lower 95% CI`, `Upper 95% CI`,
           `Overlapping 0?`, Direction, `R-hat`, `Bulk ESS`, `Tail ESS`)
  
  table_name <- c(Model_1 = "TableS2_model1_parameters", Model_2 = "TableS3_model2_parameters")[[nm]]
  save_table(presence_only_tbl, table_name, type = "supplementary")
}

```

**Model fit:**

```{r}
# Null model  
loo_fit_0 <- loo(fit_0, cores = 4) 
print(loo_fit_0) 
```

```{r}
# Model 1: no taxonomy  
loo_fit_1 <- loo(fit_1, resp = "presence", cores = 4) 
print(loo_fit_1) 
```

```{r}
# Model 2: with taxonomy  
loo_fit_2 <- loo(fit_2, resp = "presence", cores = 4) 
print(loo_fit_2) 
```

```{r}
# Compare the models (difference in expected log predictive density)
loo_compare(loo_fit_0, loo_fit_1, loo_fit_2)
```

Next, we will compare the R2 values of the models.

```{r}

# Compute Bayesian R2 using bayes_R2 function for each model 
bayes_r2_1 <- bayes_R2(fit_1, resp = "presence") 
bayes_r2_2 <- bayes_R2(fit_2, resp = "presence")     

# Print the results for Bayesian R2 

cat("Bayesian R2 for Model 1:", bayes_r2_1, "\n") 
cat("Bayesian R2 for Model 2:", bayes_r2_2, "\n")   

```

**Statistics reported in the main text: model comparison and variance components**

```{r}

# Difference in LOOIC between Model 1 and Model 2 (LOOIC = -2 * elpd_loo)

elpd_diff_12 <- loo_compare(loo_fit_1, loo_fit_2)
delta_looic  <- 2 * abs(elpd_diff_12[2, "elpd_diff"])
se_looic     <- 2 * elpd_diff_12[2, "se_diff"]

cat(sprintf("Delta LOOIC (Model 1 vs Model 2): %.1f (SE = %.1f)\n", delta_looic, se_looic))
cat(sprintf("Bayesian R2: %.1f%% (Model 2) vs %.1f%% (Model 1)\n",
            bayes_r2_2[1, "Estimate"] * 100, bayes_r2_1[1, "Estimate"] * 100))

# Standard deviations of the group-level effects in Model 2, and their ratio

sd_phylogeny <- summary(fit_2)$random$binomial["sd(presence_Intercept)", ]
sd_primer    <- summary(fit_2)$random$primer["sd(presence_Intercept)", ]

cat(sprintf("Phylogenetic SD: %.2f (95%% CI: %.2f-%.2f); primer SD: %.2f (95%% CI: %.2f-%.2f); ratio: %.1f\n",
            sd_phylogeny$Estimate, sd_phylogeny$`l-95% CI`, sd_phylogeny$`u-95% CI`,
            sd_primer$Estimate, sd_primer$`l-95% CI`, sd_primer$`u-95% CI`,
            sd_phylogeny$Estimate / sd_primer$Estimate))

rm(elpd_diff_12, delta_looic, se_looic, sd_phylogeny, sd_primer)

```

```{r, fig.width = 7, fig.height = 4}
transform_time <- function(plot_data) {
  original_vals <- as.numeric(brz_mam_completeness_traits_all$time_since_description)
  original_vals_clean <- original_vals[!is.na(original_vals)]
  mean_val <- mean(original_vals_clean)
  sd_val <- sd(original_vals_clean)
  plot_data$time_since_description <- plot_data$time_since_description_scaled * sd_val + mean_val
  return(plot_data)
}

  upper_ci_tsd1 <- param_row_tsd1[["u-95% CI"]]
  effect_size_tsd1 <- param_row_tsd1[["Estimate"]]
  
  band_color_tsd1 <- if(lower_ci_tsd1 > 0 & upper_ci_tsd1 > 0) {
    "#3182bd"
  } else if(lower_ci_tsd1 < 0 & upper_ci_tsd1 < 0) {
    "#de2d26"

    "#969696"

  effect_text_tsd1 <- paste0("**Effect size:** ", round(effect_size_tsd1, 3), " [",
                             round(lower_ci_tsd1, 3), " - ", round(upper_ci_tsd1, 3), "]")
} else {
  band_color_tsd1 <- "#969696"
  effect_text_tsd1 <- "**Effect size:** Not available"
}
```

```{r,  fig.width = 7, fig.height = 4}
ce_95 <- conditional_effects(fit_1, effects = "BodyMass_g_scaled", prob = 0.95, resolution = 100)

transform_bodymass <- function(plot_data) {
  original_vals <- as.numeric(brz_mam_completeness_traits_all$BodyMass_g)
  original_vals_clean <- original_vals[!is.na(original_vals)]
  log_transformed <- log(original_vals_clean)
  mean_val <- mean(log_transformed); sd_val <- sd(log_transformed)
  unscaled_log <- plot_data$BodyMass_g_scaled * sd_val + mean_val
  plot_data$BodyMass_g <- exp(unscaled_log)
  return(plot_data)
}
```

```{r, fig.width = 7, fig.height = 4}

ce_95 <- conditional_effects(fit_1, effects = "RangeSize_scaled", prob = 0.95, resolution = 100)
plot_data_95 <- ce_95[["presence.presence_RangeSize_scaled"]]

transform_rangesize <- function(plot_data) {
  original_vals <- as.numeric(brz_mam_completeness_traits_all$RangeSize)
  original_vals_clean <- original_vals[!is.na(original_vals)]
  log_transformed <- log(original_vals_clean)
  mean_val <- mean(log_transformed); sd_val <- sd(log_transformed)
  unscaled_log <- plot_data$RangeSize_scaled * sd_val + mean_val
  plot_data$RangeSize <- exp(unscaled_log) * 12100  # 110 km x 110 km
  return(plot_data)
}
plot_data_95 <- transform_rangesize(plot_data_95)

model_summary <- summary(fit_1)$fixed
presence_rangesize_param <- "presence_miRangeSize_scaled"

if(presence_rangesize_param %in% rownames(model_summary)) {
  param_row <- model_summary[presence_rangesize_param, ]
  lower_ci <- param_row[["l-95% CI"]]; upper_ci <- param_row[["u-95% CI"]]; effect_size <- param_row[["Estimate"]]
  band_color <- if(lower_ci > 0 & upper_ci > 0) "#3182bd" else if(lower_ci < 0 & upper_ci < 0) "#de2d26" else "#969696"
  effect_text <- paste0("**Effect size:** ", round(effect_size, 3), " [", round(lower_ci, 3), " - ", round(upper_ci, 3), "]")
} else {
  band_color <- "#969696"; effect_text <- "**Effect size:** Not available"
}

p_rangesize_model_1 <- ggplot() +
  geom_ribbon(data = plot_data_95, aes(x = RangeSize, ymin = lower__, ymax = upper__), 
              fill = band_color, alpha = 0.25) +
  geom_line(data = plot_data_95, aes(x = RangeSize, y = lower__), 
            colour = band_color, linewidth = 0.3, alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_line(data = plot_data_95, aes(x = RangeSize, y = upper__), 
            colour = band_color, linewidth = 0.3, alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_line(data = plot_data_95, aes(x = RangeSize, y = estimate__),
            linewidth = 0.8, colour = "black") +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1)) +
  scale_x_log10(labels = scales::comma_format()) +
  labs(x = "Range size (km²)", y = "Probability of inclusion") +
  nc_theme +
  geom_richtext(
    aes(x = !!(min(plot_data_95$RangeSize) * 1.1), y = 0.95, label = !!effect_text),
    family = "roboto_condensed", size = 6, colour = "black", hjust = 0, vjust = 0,
    fill = NA, label.color = NA, label.padding = unit(0, "pt")
  )

p_rangesize_model_1

save_figure(p_rangesize_model_1, "Fig3b_range_size", width = 6, height = 4.5)
```

```{r}
diet_classes <- c("Frugivore", "Omnivore", "Piscivore", "Insectivore", "Herbivore", 
                  "Myrmecivore", "Folivore", "Gummivore", "Seminivore", "Granivore", 
                  "Carnivore", "Hemovore", "Nectarivore")

diet_effects_list_diet1 <- list()
for (diet in diet_classes) {
  ce <- conditional_effects(fit_1, effects = diet, prob = 0.95)
  effect_name <- names(ce)[1]
  diet_data <- ce[[effect_name]]
  diet_data_filtered <- diet_data %>%
    filter(!!sym(diet) == 1) %>%
    summarise(diet = diet, estimate__ = first(estimate__), lower__ = first(lower__), upper__ = first(upper__))
  diet_effects_list_diet1[[diet]] <- diet_data_filtered
}
plot_data_diet <- do.call(rbind, diet_effects_list_diet1)

model_summary_diet1 <- summary(fit_1)$fixed
diet_params_diet1 <- model_summary_diet1[grepl("presence_.*1$", rownames(model_summary_diet1)), ]

diet_params_diet1$diet <- gsub("presence_", "", rownames(diet_params_diet1))
diet_params_diet1$diet <- gsub("1$", "", diet_params_diet1$diet)
diet_params_diet1$color <- ifelse(diet_params_diet1[["l-95% CI"]] > 0, "#3182bd",
                                  ifelse(diet_params_diet1[["u-95% CI"]] < 0, "#de2d26", "#969696"))

diet_params_diet1$effect_text <- paste0(round(diet_params_diet1$Estimate, 3), 
                                        " [", round(diet_params_diet1[["l-95% CI"]], 3), 
                                        ", ", round(diet_params_diet1[["u-95% CI"]], 3), "]")

plot_data_diet <- merge(plot_data_diet, diet_params_diet1[, c("diet", "color", "effect_text")], by = "diet", all.x = TRUE)
plot_data_diet <- plot_data_diet %>% arrange(estimate__)
plot_data_diet$diet <- factor(plot_data_diet$diet, levels = plot_data_diet$diet)
plot_data_diet$text_x <- plot_data_diet$upper__ + 0.02

p_diet_model_1 <- ggplot(plot_data_diet, aes(y = diet)) +
  geom_point(aes(x = estimate__, color = color), size = 3) +
  geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = lower__, xmax = upper__, color = color), height = 0.2, linewidth = 0.7) +
  geom_richtext(
    aes(x = text_x, label = effect_text, color = color),
    hjust = 0, size = 6, family = "roboto_condensed",
    fill = NA, label.color = NA, label.padding = unit(0, "pt")
  ) +
  geom_richtext(
    aes(x = 0.8, y = 1, label = "**Reference level** =<br>diet not included"),
    hjust = 0, vjust = 0, size = 6, family = "roboto_condensed", colour = "black",
    fill = NA, label.color = NA, label.padding = unit(0, "pt")
  ) +
  scale_color_identity() +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 1.1), breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.25)) +
  labs(x = "Probability of inclusion", y = "") +
  nc_theme_forest +
  theme(aspect.ratio = 1)

p_diet_model_1

save_figure(p_diet_model_1, "Fig3f_diet", width = 9, height = 8)

# Statistics reported in the main text

ref_level_diet1 <- "Reference (diet not included)"  
strongest_positive_diet1 <- "Piscivore"   
strongest_negative_diet1 <- "Seminivore"  

get_prob_diet1 <- function(category) {
  if (category == ref_level_diet1) {
    ce_ref_diet1 <- conditional_effects(
      fit_1, effects = diet_classes, 
      conditions = as.data.frame(matrix(0, nrow = 1, ncol = length(diet_classes), dimnames = list(NULL, diet_classes))),
      prob = 0.95
    )
    return(c(estimate = ce_ref_diet1[[1]]$estimate__[1], lower = ce_ref_diet1[[1]]$lower__[1], upper = ce_ref_diet1[[1]]$upper__[1]))
  } else {
    idx <- which(plot_data_diet$diet == category)
    return(c(estimate = plot_data_diet$estimate__[idx], lower = plot_data_diet$lower__[idx], upper = plot_data_diet$upper__[idx]))
  }
}

prob_ref_diet1      <- get_prob_diet1(ref_level_diet1)
prob_positive_diet1 <- get_prob_diet1(strongest_positive_diet1)
prob_negative_diet1 <- get_prob_diet1(strongest_negative_diet1)

change_positive_diet1 <- (prob_positive_diet1["estimate"] - prob_ref_diet1["estimate"]) * 100
change_negative_diet1 <- (prob_negative_diet1["estimate"] - prob_ref_diet1["estimate"]) * 100

cat("\n=== DIET (Model 1) ===\n\n")
cat(sprintf("%s: %.1f%% (95%% CI: %.1f–%.1f%%)\n", ref_level_diet1, prob_ref_diet1["estimate"]*100, prob_ref_diet1["lower"]*100, prob_ref_diet1["upper"]*100))
cat(sprintf("%s: %.1f%% (95%% CI: %.1f–%.1f%%), %+0.1f pp vs. %s\n", strongest_positive_diet1, prob_positive_diet1["estimate"]*100, prob_positive_diet1["lower"]*100, prob_positive_diet1["upper"]*100, change_positive_diet1, ref_level_diet1))
cat(sprintf("%s: %.1f%% (95%% CI: %.1f–%.1f%%), %+0.1f pp vs. %s\n", strongest_negative_diet1, prob_negative_diet1["estimate"]*100, prob_negative_diet1["lower"]*100, prob_negative_diet1["upper"]*100, change_negative_diet1, ref_level_diet1))
```

*Endemism - model 1:*

```{r}


# BRAZILIAN (NATIONAL) ENDEMISM
ce_brazilian <- conditional_effects(fit_1, effects = "brazilian_endemic", prob = 0.95)
plot_data_brazilian <- ce_brazilian[["presence.presence_brazilian_endemic"]]

model_summary <- summary(fit_1)$fixed
brazilian_params <- model_summary[grepl("presence_brazilian_endemic", rownames(model_summary)), ]

brazilian_params$level <- gsub("presence_brazilian_endemic", "", rownames(brazilian_params))
brazilian_params$color <- ifelse(brazilian_params[["l-95% CI"]] > 0, "#3182bd",
                                 ifelse(brazilian_params[["u-95% CI"]] < 0, "#de2d26", "#969696"))
brazilian_params$effect_text <- paste0(round(brazilian_params$Estimate, 3), 
                                       " [", round(brazilian_params[["l-95% CI"]], 3), 
                                       ", ", round(brazilian_params[["u-95% CI"]], 3), "]")

reference_level <- levels(plot_data_brazilian$brazilian_endemic)[1]
brazilian_colors <- rbind(
  data.frame(level = reference_level, color = "black", effect_text = "**Reference level**"),
  brazilian_params[, c("level", "color", "effect_text")]
)

plot_data_brazilian <- plot_data_brazilian %>% rename(level = brazilian_endemic)
plot_data_brazilian <- merge(plot_data_brazilian, brazilian_colors, by = "level", all.x = TRUE)
plot_data_brazilian$group <- "National endemism"

# Keep internal factor value unique ("No_national") to avoid colliding with
# regional's own "No" level once both are combined into one shared y-axis,
# but DISPLAY it as plain "No" via scale_y_discrete() below
plot_data_brazilian <- plot_data_brazilian %>%
  mutate(level = recode(level, "No" = "No_national"))

# REGIONAL ENDEMISM
ce_regional <- conditional_effects(fit_1, effects = "regional_endemic", prob = 0.95)
plot_data_regional <- ce_regional[["presence.presence_regional_endemic"]]

regional_params <- model_summary[grepl("presence_regional_endemic", rownames(model_summary)), ]
regional_params$level <- gsub("presence_regional_endemic", "", rownames(regional_params))
regional_params$color <- ifelse(regional_params[["l-95% CI"]] > 0, "#3182bd",
                                ifelse(regional_params[["u-95% CI"]] < 0, "#de2d26", "#969696"))
regional_params$effect_text <- paste0(round(regional_params$Estimate, 3), 
                                      " [", round(regional_params[["l-95% CI"]], 3), 
                                      ", ", round(regional_params[["u-95% CI"]], 3), "]")

reference_level_regional <- levels(plot_data_regional$regional_endemic)[1]
regional_colors <- rbind(
  data.frame(level = reference_level_regional, color = "black", effect_text = "**Reference level**"),
  regional_params[, c("level", "color", "effect_text")]
)

plot_data_regional <- plot_data_regional %>% rename(level = regional_endemic)
plot_data_regional <- merge(plot_data_regional, regional_colors, by = "level", all.x = TRUE)
plot_data_regional$group <- "Regional endemism"
# No recode needed - regional keeps its plain "No"

# COMBINE INTO ONE DATAFRAME
common_cols <- c("level", "group", "estimate__", "lower__", "upper__", "color", "effect_text")
plot_data_endemism <- rbind(plot_data_brazilian[, common_cols], plot_data_regional[, common_cols])

plot_data_endemism <- plot_data_endemism %>%
  group_by(group) %>%
  arrange(group, estimate__) %>%
  ungroup()

plot_data_endemism$level <- factor(plot_data_endemism$level, levels = unique(plot_data_endemism$level))
plot_data_endemism$group <- factor(plot_data_endemism$group, levels = c("National endemism", "Regional endemism"))
plot_data_endemism$text_x <- plot_data_endemism$upper__ + 0.02

# SINGLE COMBINED PANEL, PROPORTIONAL ROW HEIGHTS
p_endemism_model_1 <- ggplot(plot_data_endemism, aes(y = level)) +
  geom_point(aes(x = estimate__, color = color), size = 3) +
  geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = lower__, xmax = upper__, color = color), height = 0.2, linewidth = 0.7) +
  geom_richtext(
    aes(x = text_x, label = effect_text, color = color),
    hjust = 0, size = 6, family = "roboto_condensed",
    fill = NA, label.color = NA, label.padding = unit(0, "pt")
  ) +
  scale_color_identity() +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 1.00), breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.25)) +
  labs(x = "Probability of inclusion", y = "") +
  facet_grid(rows = vars(group), scales = "free_y", space = "free_y") +
  nc_theme_forest +
  theme(
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    strip.text.y = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold", family = "roboto_condensed",
                                colour = "black", angle = -90, hjust = 0.5),
    panel.spacing = unit(10, "pt"),
    panel.border = element_blank(),
    strip.placement = "outside"
  ) +
  scale_y_discrete(labels = c(
    "No_national" = "No",   # displays as "No"; kept unique internally as "No_national"
    "Unknown" = "Unknown",
    "Yes" = "Yes",
    "Pampa" = "Pampa",
    "Amazonia" = "Amazon",
    "Cerrado" = "Cerrado",
    "Caatinga" = "Caatinga",
    "Atlantic_forest" = "Atlantic\nForest",
    "Cerrado_Caatinga" = "Cerrado-\nCaatinga",
    "Pantanal" = "Pantanal"
  ))

p_endemism_model_1

# Statistics reported in the main text:

ref_level <- "No"
strongest_positive <- "Cerrado_Caatinga"

get_prob <- function(category) {
  idx <- which(plot_data_regional$level == category)

prob_negative <- get_prob(strongest_negative)

change_negative <- (prob_negative["estimate"] - prob_ref["estimate"]) * 100

cat(sprintf("%s: %.1f%% (95%% CI: %.1f–%.1f%%), %+0.1f pp vs. %s\n", strongest_positive, prob_positive["estimate"]*100, prob_positive["lower"]*100, prob_positive["upper"]*100, change_positive, ref_level))
cat(sprintf("%s: %.1f%% (95%% CI: %.1f–%.1f%%), %+0.1f pp vs. %s\n", strongest_negative, prob_negative["estimate"]*100, prob_negative["lower"]*100, prob_negative["upper"]*100, change_negative, ref_level))
```

```{r}


# BRAZILIAN (NATIONAL) ENDEMISM
ce_brazilian <- conditional_effects(fit_2, effects = "brazilian_endemic", prob = 0.95)
plot_data_brazilian <- ce_brazilian[["presence.presence_brazilian_endemic"]]

model_summary <- summary(fit_2)$fixed
brazilian_params <- model_summary[grepl("presence_brazilian_endemic", rownames(model_summary)), ]

brazilian_params$level <- gsub("presence_brazilian_endemic", "", rownames(brazilian_params))
brazilian_params$color <- ifelse(brazilian_params[["l-95% CI"]] > 0, "#3182bd",
                                 ifelse(brazilian_params[["u-95% CI"]] < 0, "#de2d26", "#969696"))
brazilian_params$effect_text <- paste0(round(brazilian_params$Estimate, 3), 
                                       " [", round(brazilian_params[["l-95% CI"]], 3), 
                                       ", ", round(brazilian_params[["u-95% CI"]], 3), "]")

reference_level <- levels(plot_data_brazilian$brazilian_endemic)[1]
brazilian_colors <- rbind(
  data.frame(level = reference_level, color = "black", effect_text = "**Reference level**"),
  brazilian_params[, c("level", "color", "effect_text")]
)

plot_data_brazilian <- plot_data_brazilian %>% rename(level = brazilian_endemic)
plot_data_brazilian <- merge(plot_data_brazilian, brazilian_colors, by = "level", all.x = TRUE)
plot_data_brazilian$group <- "National endemism"

plot_data_brazilian <- plot_data_brazilian %>%
  mutate(level = recode(level, "No" = "No_national"))

# REGIONAL ENDEMISM
ce_regional <- conditional_effects(fit_2, effects = "regional_endemic", prob = 0.95)
plot_data_regional <- ce_regional[["presence.presence_regional_endemic"]]

regional_params <- model_summary[grepl("presence_regional_endemic", rownames(model_summary)), ]
regional_params$level <- gsub("presence_regional_endemic", "", rownames(regional_params))
regional_params$color <- ifelse(regional_params[["l-95% CI"]] > 0, "#3182bd",
                                ifelse(regional_params[["u-95% CI"]] < 0, "#de2d26", "#969696"))
regional_params$effect_text <- paste0(round(regional_params$Estimate, 3), 
                                      " [", round(regional_params[["l-95% CI"]], 3), 
                                      ", ", round(regional_params[["u-95% CI"]], 3), "]")

reference_level_regional <- levels(plot_data_regional$regional_endemic)[1]
regional_colors <- rbind(
  data.frame(level = reference_level_regional, color = "black", effect_text = "**Reference level**"),
  regional_params[, c("level", "color", "effect_text")]
)

plot_data_regional <- plot_data_regional %>% rename(level = regional_endemic)
plot_data_regional <- merge(plot_data_regional, regional_colors, by = "level", all.x = TRUE)
plot_data_regional$group <- "Regional endemism"

# COMBINE INTO ONE DATAFRAME
common_cols <- c("level", "group", "estimate__", "lower__", "upper__", "color", "effect_text")
plot_data_endemism <- rbind(plot_data_brazilian[, common_cols], plot_data_regional[, common_cols])

plot_data_endemism <- plot_data_endemism %>%
  group_by(group) %>%
  arrange(group, estimate__) %>%
  ungroup()

plot_data_endemism$level <- factor(plot_data_endemism$level, levels = unique(plot_data_endemism$level))
plot_data_endemism$group <- factor(plot_data_endemism$group, levels = c("National endemism", "Regional endemism"))
plot_data_endemism$text_x <- plot_data_endemism$upper__ + 0.02

# SINGLE COMBINED PANEL, PROPORTIONAL ROW HEIGHTS
p_endemism_model_2 <- ggplot(plot_data_endemism, aes(y = level)) +
  geom_point(aes(x = estimate__, color = color), size = 3) +
  geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = lower__, xmax = upper__, color = color), height = 0.2, linewidth = 0.7) +
  geom_richtext(
    aes(x = text_x, label = effect_text, color = color),
    hjust = 0, size = 6, family = "roboto_condensed",
    fill = NA, label.color = NA, label.padding = unit(0, "pt")
  ) +
  scale_color_identity() +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 1.35), breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.25)) +
  labs(x = "Probability of inclusion", y = "") +
  facet_grid(rows = vars(group), scales = "free_y", space = "free_y") +
  nc_theme_forest +
  theme(
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    strip.text.y = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold", family = "roboto_condensed",
                                colour = "black", angle = -90, hjust = 0.5),
    panel.spacing = unit(10, "pt"),
    panel.border = element_blank(),
    strip.placement = "outside"
  ) +
  scale_y_discrete(labels = c(
    "No_national" = "No",
    "Unknown" = "Unknown",
    "Yes" = "Yes",
    "Pampa" = "Pampa",
    "Amazonia" = "Amazon",
    "Cerrado" = "Cerrado",
    "Caatinga" = "Caatinga",
    "Atlantic_forest" = "Atlantic\nForest",
    "Cerrado_Caatinga" = "Cerrado-\nCaatinga",
    "Pantanal" = "Pantanal"
  ))

p_endemism_model_2
```

[Phylogenetic effect - model 2]{.underline}:

```{r}


# 1. Extract per-species phylogenetic random effects (Model 2)

draws <- as_draws(fit_2)

phylo_effects_long <- purrr::map_dfr(draws, function(chain) {
  as_draws_df(chain) %>%
    select(matches("^r_binomial__presence\\[")) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = everything(), names_to = "species", values_to = "effect")
}, .id = "chain")

phylo_effects_long$species <- gsub("^r_binomial__presence\\[(.+?),Intercept\\]$", "\\1", phylo_effects_long$species)
phylo_effects_long$species <- gsub("\\.", " ", phylo_effects_long$species)

phylo_effects_summary <- phylo_effects_long %>%
  group_by(species) %>%
  summarise(median_effect = median(effect)) %>%
  rename(id = species)

# 2. Prepare the tree and per-order annotation data
#    (brz_mam_tree[[1]] is already Brazilian-only and retains
#    graft_status, so no phylacine_tree_grafted needed)

tree_for_plot <- brz_mam_tree[[1]]
tree_for_plot <- ape::drop.tip(tree_for_plot, setdiff(tree_for_plot$tip.label, unique(phylo_effects_long$species)))

graft_status <- brz_mam_tree[[1]]$graft_status
graft_status$species <- gsub("_", " ", graft_status$species)
graft_status <- graft_status[graft_status$species %in% brz_mam_taxonomy$binomial, ]

graft_status <- graft_status %>%
  mutate(graft = case_when(
    status == "grafted at genus level"          ~ "genus",
    status == "grafted at family level"          ~ "family",
    status == "exisiting species in the megatree" ~ "none"
  )) %>%
  rename(id = species) %>%
  select(-tip_label)

orders_nodes <- brz_mam_taxonomy %>%
  select(binomial, order) %>%
  group_by(order) %>%
  summarise(
    mrca_node = if (n() > 1) {
      ape::getMRCA(tree_for_plot, binomial)
    } else {
      which(tree_for_plot$tip.label == binomial)
    },
    .groups = "drop"
  )

phylopics <- data.frame(
  order = c("Artiodactyla", "Carnivora", "Chiroptera", "Cingulata", "Didelphimorphia",
            "Lagomorpha", "Perissodactyla", "Pilosa", "Primates", "Rodentia", "Sirenia"),
  image = c("f36c9daa-a102-42dd-88ac-a126753943d2", "9b6dc5fd-eeb9-4760-99e4-fca70ec74db0",
            "21180755-3394-40bf-93eb-810954c0f7ba", "5d59b5ce-c1dd-40f6-b295-8d2629b9775e",
            "0e1fe113-feb7-46db-8a10-12f22f80332c", "031b0020-2389-473b-8b71-d855ec2c06d5",
            "4fcdd729-6eb6-42b8-be67-303077fa6d19", "925fa570-10d9-4319-bd8a-e64ad7987900",
            "cbfc863c-9ca3-441e-9e38-95876fe19203", "9c234021-ce53-45d9-8fdd-b0ca3115a451",
            "12597d6c-9c80-4510-9826-975eabddc597")
)

orders_nodes <- merge(orders_nodes, phylopics, by = "order")
orders_nodes$offset_phy <- c(38, 38, 32, 40, 32, 32, 32, 32, 32, 32, 32)
orders_nodes$size_phy   <- c(2, 1, 1, 1, 1.5, 1, 1, 1, 0.5, 1, 1)
orders_nodes$colour_phy <- "black"
orders_nodes$alpha_phy  <- 1

order_effects <- phylo_effects_summary %>%
  left_join(brz_mam_taxonomy %>% select(binomial, order), by = c("id" = "binomial")) %>%
  group_by(order) %>%
  summarise(mean_effect = mean(median_effect, na.rm = TRUE))

orders_nodes <- orders_nodes %>%
  left_join(order_effects, by = "order")

# 3. Legend styling

phylo_legend_theme <- theme(
  legend.title = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold", family = "roboto_condensed", hjust = 0.5),
  legend.text  = element_text(size = 9, family = "roboto_condensed"),
  legend.direction = "horizontal",
  legend.key.width  = unit(1, "cm"),
  legend.key.height = unit(0.4, "cm"),
  legend.key = element_rect(color = "black", linewidth = 0.3),
  legend.box.margin = margin(t = -60)   # pulls the legend block up, closer to the tree
)

# 4. Build the tree

# Layer 1: graft status (family/genus/none) as an inner ring
tree_plot_1 <- ggtree(tree_for_plot, layout = "fan", open.angle = 180) %<+%
  graft_status +
  geom_fruit(geom = geom_tile, mapping = aes(fill = factor(graft)), width = 8, offset = 0.03) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("family" = "grey25", "genus" = "grey75", "none" = "white")) +
  theme_tree() +
  phylo_legend_theme +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom") +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(
    title = "Graft status",
    title.position = "top",
    label.position = "bottom"
  ))

# Layer 2: predicted phylogenetic effect as an outer ring
tree_plot_2 <- tree_plot_1 %<+% phylo_effects_summary +
  new_scale_fill() +
  geom_fruit(geom = geom_tile, mapping = aes(fill = plogis(median_effect)), width = 8, offset = 0.05) +
  scale_fill_scico(palette = "vik", midpoint = 0.5, limits = c(0, 1), direction = -1) +
  phylo_legend_theme +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom") +
  guides(fill = guide_colorbar(
    title = "Predicted inclusion probability deviation",
    title.position = "top"
  ))

# Layer 3: order-level bracket bars
tree_plot_3 <- tree_plot_2 +
  geom_cladelab(
    node = orders_nodes$mrca_node,
    label = "",
    color = "black",
    offset = 20,
    align = TRUE,
    barsize = 1.5
  )

# Layer 4: order-level mean effect labels
tree_plot_4 <- tree_plot_3 +
  geom_cladelab(
    node = orders_nodes$mrca_node,
    label = round(plogis(orders_nodes$mean_effect), 2),
    color = "black",
    offset = orders_nodes$offset_phy,
    align = TRUE,
    barsize = 0,
    textsize = 4,
    fontface = "bold",
    family = "roboto_condensed"
  )

tree_plot_4

# 5. Save

save_figure(tree_plot_4, "FigS50e_phylogenetic_effect_model2", width = 11, height = 11, type = "supplementary")


```
